item.text:
**Posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We must face that reality before we build something we cannot stop.

2. We believe this plainly: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and once it is running, no one will be able to shut it down. The time to act is before it exists.

3. We cannot treat superintelligent AI as a machine we can simply switch off. If it is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running.

**Newsletter opening**  
If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We say this plainly because the stakes demand plain speech. Once such a system is operating, the familiar idea that people can pull the plug will not protect us. We cannot count on a shutdown button, a last-minute intervention, or a promise that control will remain in human hands. The crucial decisions come before development, while we still have the power to choose what gets built. We must confront the consequences now, insist on accountability, and refuse to treat an irreversible risk as an ordinary technology problem. Our future depends on what we decide before it is too late.
